This second bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in case crime No. 46/2020,
under Section 376(D) IPC, police station Kothibhar, District Maharajganj with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
The first bail application of the applicant was rejected by this Court vide order dated 1.4.2022 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 40063 of 2021.

2. Heard leaned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material brought on record.
3. According to prosecution version, father of victim girl has left the victim at the railway station as she has to go to the house of her maternal uncle and while she was waiting for train at the railway station, co-accused Ram Snehi mixed some intoxicant in her tea and thereafter applicant and Lala @ Rahul Srivastava vs State Of U.P. on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/137559153/
1 co-accused persons have committed rape upon her.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the accused-applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
It was submitted that alleged incident has been shown of 20.02.2020 but FIR has been lodged after four days on 24.02.2020.

It was further submitted that in the medical examination report of victim,
no external or internal injury has been shown.

Statement of victim, recorded under Section 164 CrPC, was referred and it has been submitted that main allegations are against co-accused Ram Snehi that he has committed rape upon the victim and later on victim has alleged that applicant and other accused persons have also committed rape upon her.
The version of victim girl is not supported by medical evidence.

Co-accused persons namely, Rajkumar Gaur and Ramsanehi have already been granted bail by the coordinate Benches of this Court vide orders dated 10.7.2023 and 5.3.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application Nos. 27400 of 2020 and 6476 of 2024 respectively.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application Nos. 27400 of 2020 and 6476 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: It was further argued that the applicant is in judicial custody since 25.02.2020 and thus, he has already undergone the detention of more than four years.
It was submitted that the applicant has no criminal history and that in case applicant is enlarged on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.

4. On the other hand, learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and argued that applicant is named in the FIR and there are allegations that co-accused Ram Snehi has mixed some intoxicant in the tea of victim and thereafter she was subjected to gang rape by applicant and co-accused persons.
However, it could not be disputed that the aforementioned co-accused persons have already been enlarged on bail by this Court.

5. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations and all attending facts, particularly period of detention, without expressing any opinion on merits of case,
the Court is of the view that a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

6. Let the applicant Lala alias Rahul Srivastava involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i.
The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii. The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
7. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant, in accordance with law.
